answer: Resist sybils with origin-keyed quadratic vote pricing. Accounts sharing one origin merge into a single voting thread, and each vote logs a fee entry to that origin's plume ledger. The k-th vote costs 0.25*k^2 units and burns. Steps: (1) registry groups accounts by origin; (2) votes rank by fee tier; (3) weight per tier is 1/sqrt(k). An attacker running 10 sybils pays 0.25*(1+4+...+100)=68.75 units for 10% weight in a 100-voter pool; honest voters pay 0.25. A 2.00-unit timber bond per origin is forfeited when the per-round vote cap of 3 is exceeded.
